evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live custom-interface registry.
The builder patches/builds the classic skills surface rooted at widget 3917 and uses exact 'skills/SKILL' sprite resources.

It owns exact skill labels for Attack, Hitpoints, Mining, Strength, Agility, Smithing, Defence, Herblore, Fishing, Range, Thieving, Cooking, Prayer, Crafting, Firemaking, Magic, Fletching, Woodcutting, Runecrafting, Slayer, Farming, Construction, Hunter and Summoning.
It creates exact 'Total Level: 0' presentation and the per-skill level/hover surfaces, fixing the role as the client skills interface.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 client skills presentation identity; no XP formula or server skill authority is inferred.

evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live custom-interface registry.
The builder configures multiple weapon-style interface roots and associated style buttons rather than one single weapon instance.
Exact attack-style labels include Chop, Hack, Smash, Block, Stab, Lunge, Slash, Pound, Pummel, Spike, Swipe and related style families.

Exact hover/description text includes Accurate/Attack XP, Aggressive/Strength XP, Controlled/Shared XP and Defensive/Defence XP across stab/slash/crush styles, fixing the class as the combat-style interface catalogue.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 client combat-style presentation builder; no combat formula or server attack semantics are inferred.
